792:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Through $$万丈$$'s connections, we've made contact with the resistance in various regions and gotten a grasp of the situation on $$翠の地球$$ as well.」

792:t_1:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Judging by the situation, $$サイデリアル$$'s main force has indeed shifted to $$蒼の地球$$.」

792:t_1:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The center of the fighting here right now is the southern part of the Central Continent, the largest continent on $$翠の地球$$...」

792:t_1:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「According to $$万丈$$, our former comrades are fighting on that continent, too.」

792:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Shall we join up with them?」

792:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... I think it would work better as a check on $$サイデリアル$$ if they and we each move independently.」

792:t_1:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Another point that concerns me is $$サイデリアル$$'s movements in the $$残されの海$$.」

792:t_1:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「The sea where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is, huh... I wouldn't have thought it holds any strategic value, though...」

792:t_1:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「Which is exactly why we need to be wary of the fact that they're engaged in some kind of activity there.」

792:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I propose this as our strategy from here on.」

792:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Move the $c main force to either the Central Continent, the center of the fighting, or the $$残されの海$$, where suspicious activity has been seen...」

792:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And to whichever area we don't choose, we send a force suited to operating there.」

792:t_1:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Deploying the main force and a detached force at the same time, then.」

792:t_1:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Since we have no time to spare here, I suppose that is the most appropriate course.」

792:t_1:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let's see... If we go to the Central Continent, we'll probably use Japan along the way as a relay base, so...」

792:t_1:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let's send $$ザンボット３$$ and $$ダイターン３$$ at the core, along with the $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, and the $$クラッシャー隊$$, who work well together.」

792:t_1:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then to the $$残されの海$$, we'll send Ensign $$レド$$, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ and Captain $$ガムリン$$.」

792:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「That leaves the question of which way to move the main force.」

792:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the main force heads for the Central Continent, we'll have $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ and Ensign $$レド$$ and the others go to the $$残されの海$$ as a detached force, and...」

792:t_1:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the main force heads for the $$残されの海$$, we'll send $$ザンボット３$$, $$ダイターン３$$, the $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, and the $$クラッシャー隊$$ to $$ガリア$$.」

792:t_1:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let's have Captain $$ジェフリー$$, who has combat experience on $$翠の地球$$, decide the main force's course of action.」

792:t_1:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The main force will head for the Central Continent.」
「The main force will head for the $$残されの海$$.」

792:t_1:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then the main force, head for the Central Continent. The $$クォーター$$ will go to the $$残されの海$$ with $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, Captain $$ガムリン$$ and Ensign $$レド$$.」

792:t_1:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Please stay safe as well, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

792:t_1:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ on standby in satellite orbit, we'll have it descend to join us, depending on the situation.」

792:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「On the surface, at least, he has pulled himself together, and he's working through trial and error on how to fight in the $$ジェニオン$$ now that he has lost Miss $$スズネ$$.」

792:t_1:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But he isn't the only one in dire straits. The fighting on $$翠の地球$$ will carry great meaning for getting out of it, too.」

792:t_1:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that we've already taken $$オルソン$$ back, we can expect $$サイデリアル$$ to send forces this way.」

792:t_1:35.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Central Continent and the $$残されの海$$... I'm counting on each of you to fight well.」

792:t_1:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then the main force will head for the $$残されの海$$, and we'll send the Super Robot team, starting with $$ザンボット３$$, to the Central Continent.」

792:t_1:37.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Let's leave command to $$ケンジ$$ and $$万丈$$.」

792:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ on standby in satellite orbit, we'll have it descend to join us, depending on the situation.」

792:t_1:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「On the surface, at least, he has pulled himself together, and he's working through trial and error on how to fight in the $$ジェニオン$$ now that he has lost Miss $$スズネ$$.」

792:t_1:41.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But he isn't the only one in dire straits. The fighting on $$翠の地球$$ will carry great meaning for getting out of it, too.」

792:t_1:42.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that we've already taken $$オルソン$$ back, we can expect $$サイデリアル$$ to send forces this way.」

792:t_1:43.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Central Continent and the $$残されの海$$... I'm counting on each of you to fight well.」

792:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good work on the training, $n. Here's a sports drink for you.」

792:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So how did it go? Did you pick up any hint for a new special move?」

792:t_10:7.en:
$n
「If it were that easy, I wouldn't be struggling.」

792:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And how is your record in the mock battles?」

792:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I fought $$カミーユ$$, $$スザク$$, $$シン$$, $$カレン$$, $$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, $$竜馬$$ and $$クロウ$$ five times each, and...」

792:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a heavy losing record. Not that I didn't expect it.」

792:t_10:12.en:
$n
「$$セツコ$$ pointed it out to me, but it seems I'd been relying on the power of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ without realizing it.」

792:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... In that case, I recommend sealing away GAI Mode and fighting without it on your next sortie.」

792:t_10:14.en:
$n
「In actual combat, huh... It might be worth trying.」

792:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Speaking of things worth trying, there's this, too! Another day of giving it my all...」

792:t_10:16.en:
$n
「Sorry. No matter how good the advice I get, that's the one thing I can't get motivated to do.」

792:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's pull ourselves together and get going! Another day of giving it my all... business, business!」

uncertain: 792:t_1:24 and :36: Japanese says ザンボット / ダイターン without the 3; I used the tokens ザンボット３ / ダイターン３ (no bare token exists), so English reads 'Zambot 3'/'Daitarn 3'

792:t_1:36: スーパーロボットチーム rendered as plain 'the Super Robot team' (no glossary entry)
792:t_1:20: 息の合う scope ambiguous (Takeo GC only, or all the listed units); rendered 'who work well together' after the whole group
792:t_1:32: $n rendered as 'he' (protagonist is male in the shipped Tengoku lines); 'now that he has lost Miss Suzune' for スズネ先生を失った
792:t_1:23/:21/:28: Japanese 'Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ．' with trailing period uses the Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ token only (token English already ends in a period)
792:t_1:30/:38: こちらに降下 rendered 'descend to join us'
792:t_10:13 etc.: ＧＡＩモード = plain 'GAI Mode' (as in shipped lines; no token); AG kept pronoun-free (gender n/a)
